text: For A ∈ M_{m×n}(F), the null space and the row space are both subspaces of Fⁿ, and their dimensions add up to ___.
explanation: dim(row space) = rank(A) = r and dim(null space) = n − r, so the sum is n. This is rank–nullity read through the four fundamental subspaces; the column space and left null space similarly split m.
